on the last line of your reply:

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    core = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not core:
        return out
    cr = sum(r for r, c in core) / len(core)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in core) / len(core)
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)} - {0, 1, 3}
    for color in colors:
        cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color}
        # Each outer arc is a unit diagonal line. Extend its two endpoints outward.
        used = set()
        for start in sorted(cells):
            if start in used:
                continue
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                r, c = start
                run = []
                while (r, c) in cells:
                    run.append((r, c)); used.add((r, c)); r += 1; c += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                mr = sum(r for r, c in run) / len(run)
                mc = sum(c for r, c in run) / len(run)
                dr = -1 if mr < cr else 1
                dc_out = -1 if mc < cc else 1
                for r, c in (run[0], run[-1]):
                    r += dr; c += dc_out
                    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                        out[r][c] = color
                        r += dr; c += dc_out
                break
    return out
'''
